Text:
Wikipedia leaves the snippet to search.

Write a description of about 150 characters for each key page, so you choose the pitch, not the crawler.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=wikipedia

Mozilla: 85 languages, no sitemap.

Publish a sitemap.xml of the pages you want found and name it in robots.txt with one Sitemap: line.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=mozilla

MDN Web Docs: 95. No JSON-LD at all.

Add one Organization block with name, url, logo, and sameAs links. AI answers use it to name and describe you.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=mdn

W3C's home pages share one title.

Translate the title and description with the page. Each language version should say what it is, in its language.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=w3c

UNESCO has llms.txt, but no HSTS.

Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of a year or more, and make the http-to-https hop a 301.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=unesco

UNICEF's date filter has no label.

Give every field a <label> or an aria-label. A placeholder is a hint, not a name, and it disappears on input.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=unicef

The World Bank: GEO 97.

Start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only to see what would break, then enforce. default-src 'self' is a start.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=worldbank

The ICRC tests a CSP. Now it can enforce it.

Read the reports for a few weeks, fix what they flag, then switch the header to Content-Security-Policy.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=icrc

MSF serves every page without HSTS.

Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains. Then consider the browser preload list.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=msf

Amnesty's robots.txt turns Bingbot away.

Audit robots.txt line by line. Blocking a search crawler removes you from every product built on its index.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=amnesty

The Guardian front page has no h1.

Give every page one h1 that names it, even a visually hidden one on a front page. Headings are how many people navigate.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=guardian

Al Jazeera marks text for voice, blocks AI.

Decide crawler by crawler. Training bots and answer bots are separate user-agents, so each can get its own rule.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=aljazeera

DW blocks framing. It skips nosniff.

Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response. One header stops browsers running a file as the wrong type.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=dw

El País sends no security headers.

Start with four headers: Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors, and a report-only CSP.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=elpais

Le Monde has a CSP that allows any https.

List the script hosts you actually use, then drop 'unsafe-eval'. A policy that allows everything blocks nothing.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=lemonde

MIT's canonical tags point to its CMS.

Canonical URLs must be public, live, and the page itself. Check them after every CMS or domain change.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=mit

Stanford's canonical leads to a 404.

Fetch every canonical URL in your test suite. It should answer 200 and name itself as canonical.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=stanford

Any site can frame Harvard's pages.

Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'. It blocks clickjacking and replaces X-Frame-Options.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=harvard

Node.js has llms.txt. Its pages share a pitch.

Write a description per page that says what that page answers. A shared one tells search nothing new.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=nodejs

Rust's pages name no canonical.

Add a self-referencing canonical to every page. It tells search which address to rank when several reach it.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=rust

13 Kubernetes pages share one title.

Add the page's purpose to its title, in its own language. Each localized home page should stand on its own in search.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=kubernetes

Apache.org runs without descriptions.

Give each page a description of about 150 characters. Search and AI answers quote it when they introduce you.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=apache

The Linux Foundation never states a language.

Add lang="en" to the html tag in the site template. One attribute fixes every page at once.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=linuxfoundation

React's docs pages have no description.

Write a one-line description per page: what it teaches and for whom. Docs pages are where it pays most.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=react

GitHub Docs sets no canonical link.

Add a self-referencing canonical to every docs page. Versioned and translated docs need it most.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=githubdocs

Stripe Docs skips the main landmark.

Wrap the primary content in one <main> element. Screen readers list it as a landmark you can jump to.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=stripedocs

Cloudflare's CSP skips 5 of 20 pages.

Set security headers once at the edge or server, not per page template. Attackers look for the weakest page.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=cloudflare

web.dev's home page has an empty headline.

Validate structured data in CI. An item with empty required fields is noise that search may ignore.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=webdev

Three Louvre pages, one title.

Give every page a unique title that leads with its topic. Tabs, bookmarks, and search results all show it.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=louvre

The Rijksmuseum's HSTS lasts 30 days.

Raise HSTS max-age to at least a year, ideally two, and make the http redirect permanent with a 301.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=rijksmuseum

Lonely Planet's home is 1.8 MB of HTML.

Move bulky inline data out of the HTML and load it when needed. Smaller documents parse and paint sooner.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=lonelyplanet

IKEA's home page is 1.9 MB of HTML.

Measure HTML weight in CI with a budget. Inline state and repeated markup are the usual culprits.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=ikea

75,000 free books, no Book markup.

Add Book JSON-LD to each title page: name, author, inLanguage, and url. AI answers cite what they can parse.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=gutenberg

Creative Commons moves to https with 302.

Use a 301 from http to https, then add Strict-Transport-Security so browsers skip http next time.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=creativecommons

The EFF's pages send no HSTS.

Add Strict-Transport-Security with a long max-age. It tells browsers to use https before the request leaves.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=eff

Wikimedia's home page has no h1.

One h1 per page, naming what the page is. Screen-reader users often jump to it first.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=wikimedia

FAO's HTML is fast. Visitors still wait.

Find your Largest Contentful Paint element, load it early, give it a size, and never lazy-load it.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=fao

WFP's viewport turns off zoom.

Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag. Let readers zoom.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=wfp

ESA's search box has no name.

Add a visible label or aria-label to the search field. Screen readers announce the name, not the hint.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=esa

CERN's pages have no description.

Start with the home page and your ten most visited: one sentence each on what the reader will find.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=cern

NatGeo sets cookies without Secure.

Mark every cookie Secure and send Strict-Transport-Security. A visitor ID should never travel over plain http.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=natgeo

Coursera taps take 565 ms to answer.

Break long JavaScript tasks into smaller pieces and yield to the browser, so taps get a fast response.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=coursera

PHP's sitemap lists http://php.net.

Generate the sitemap from your canonical URLs: same scheme, same host. Every redirect in it wastes crawl.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=php

GNU.org answers plain http with a 200.

Redirect every http request to https with a 301. HSTS only helps after the browser has seen https once.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=gnu

Debian's search field goes unnamed.

Add <label for> or aria-label="Search" to the field. One attribute makes it usable by voice.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=debian

Ubuntu speaks Markdown and names its nginx.

Turn off version tokens (server_tokens off in nginx). Exact versions make it easy to match known flaws.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=ubuntu

PAHO has no Organization JSON-LD.

Add Organization JSON-LD with name, logo, url, and sameAs. It helps AI answers name the right agency.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=paho

DIAN's home page says it's in English.

Set lang="es" on the <html> tag of every page. Screen readers, translators, and search engines all read it.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=dian

MinEducación's sitemap lists the old address.

Build the sitemap from canonical URLs: https, the www host you serve. Redirecting entries waste crawl.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=mineducacion

MinSalud's home page links to 404s.

Run a link check on your home page every week. It's the page most people start from.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=minsalud

MinTIC's analytics stopped years ago.

Check your tags feed a live property. Move from a UA- ID to a GA4 G- ID, or remove the dead tag.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=mintic

Cancillería sends to two GA4 properties.

Keep one GA4 property per site. If two teams need the data, share access instead of adding a second tag.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=cancilleria

DANE's viewport caps zoom at 1x.

Drop maximum-scale from the viewport. width=device-width, initial-scale=1 is all most sites need.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=dane

Procuraduría's canonical host doesn't resolve.

Canonicals must use your public host. Check them after migrations, when internal hostnames leak in.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=procuraduria

ICETEX's inner pages all point to the home.

Each page's canonical should be its own URL. A template that defaults to the home URL hides every inner page.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=icetex

ICFES's HTML takes 2 s to start.

Cache the home page HTML at a CDN or in the server. Time to first byte is a floor for everything else.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=icfes

Colpensiones answers http with 503.

Keep port 80 alive just to send a 301 to https. Old links and typed addresses still arrive there.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=colpensiones

Migración Colombia has no sitemap.

Publish robots.txt with a Sitemap: line, and generate the sitemap from your CMS so it stays current.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=migracion

SATENA's pages have no canonical.

Add a self-referencing canonical to every page, plus hreflang links between the language versions.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=satena

Davivienda's robots.txt is a model. LCP isn't.

Find the Largest Contentful Paint element on your home page and serve it first: preload, size, compress.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=davivienda

Movistar's headers have a value mix-up.

Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. Recheck headers after config changes.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=movistar

Claro's home redirect drops to plain http.

Write redirects with the full https:// target. An http Location adds a hop and an unencrypted request.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=claro

Éxito's title says exito.com twice.

Write a home title that says who you are and what you offer, in under 60 characters.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=exito

Falabella's home declares no language.

Add lang="es-CO" to the <html> tag in your base template. One attribute fixes every page.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=falabella

El Tiempo still loads a retired UA tag.

Search your templates for UA- IDs and remove them. They add a request and collect nothing.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=eltiempo

Semana's description repeats its title.

Write the home description as a one-line pitch: what readers find here today, in 150 characters or less.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=semana

El Espectador has no main landmark.

Wrap each page's primary content in one <main>. Skip links and screen readers use it to find the story.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=elespectador

Uniandes skips a link in its TLS chain.

Serve the full chain: leaf plus intermediates. Test with openssl s_client or SSL Labs after every renewal.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=uniandes

SURA's home page has three h1s.

Give each page one h1 that names its topic. Use h2 and h3 for the sections below it.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=sura

Compensar lets any Azure site frame it.

List only the exact origins that embed you in frame-ancestors. Cloud wildcards include strangers.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=compensar

Ecopetrol still configures a UA ID.

Remove the UA config line and keep the GA4 one. A quarterly tag audit catches these leftovers.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=ecopetrol

Rappi's viewport sets maximum-scale=1.

Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and nothing more. Fix layout overflow instead of locking zoom.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=rappi

RTVC's search box has no label.

Add a <label> or aria-label to every input. Placeholders vanish while typing and aren't reliably announced.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=rtvc

Biblioteca Nacional's canonical says http.

Set canonicals to the exact public URL: https, your real host, no port. Check your CMS's public URL setting.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=bibliotecanacional

Supersalud loads no analytics tag.

Measure something, even a privacy-first, cookie-free tool. You can't improve pages you can't see used.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=supersalud

Contraloría's sitemap sits on port 8080.

List the sitemap's public https URL in robots.txt, then open it in a browser to check it answers.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=contraloria

ProColombia's canonical redirects back home.

A canonical must be the final URL, answering 200. Never point it at an address that redirects.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=procolombia

Nequi's hreflang points to the home page.

hreflang alternates must point to the same page in each language, including the page itself.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=nequi

Educación Bogotá has no robots.txt.

Serve a robots.txt with a Sitemap: line. Two lines of text point every crawler to your map.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=educacionbogota

Movilidad Bogotá's sitemap says default.

Set the CMS base URL to your public https address, then regenerate the sitemap.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=movilidadbogota

Salud Capital's home has three canonicals.

Emit exactly one canonical per page. Check the template, CMS, and SEO plugins for copies.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=saludcapital

Metro de Bogotá's HSTS lasts 17 minutes.

Set HSTS max-age to at least one year (31536000) once https works everywhere.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=metrobogota

IDRD's Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url.

Use strict-origin-when-cross-origin. Other sites then see only your domain, never paths or search terms.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=idrd

Idartes' https root redirects to http.

Make every redirect and canonical use https. Search for http:// in your server config and templates.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=idartes

Visit Bogotá responds slowly to taps.

Find long tasks in the Performance panel and split them. Keep INP under 200 ms.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=visitbogota

BibloRed answers plain http with a 200.

Redirect every http request to https with a 301. HSTS only counts when it arrives over https.
